root_cause.text: The `asd_pci_remove` function in the `aic94xx` SCSI driver fails to synchronize with pending tasklets associated with the `asd_ha` structure before freeing its memory, allowing concurrent tasklet execution to access freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states the function "fails to synchronize with pending tasklets before freeing the asd_ha structure," and the patch resolves this by inserting `tasklet_kill(&asd_ha->seq.dl_tasklet);` within `asd_pci_remove` prior to resource cleanup.

intent_record.intent_summary: Added explicit tasklet termination in the driver removal path to ensure safe resource deallocation.
intent_record.what: Inserted a call to tasklet_kill(&asd_ha->seq.dl_tasklet) and an explanatory comment immediately after disabling interrupts in the asd_pci_remove function.
intent_record.how: Forces the specified tasklet to stop and complete any pending work before the driver proceeds to free resources, preventing race conditions or use-after-free errors.
